hypothesis: Date-level observable forecast context predicts relative expert log loss better than context-free recent loss weighting.
material_difference: Route distributions from a shared frozen expert pool; do not correct mean residuals.
scope: Retained S3 public survivor-history development replay and generated mechanism tests. All market outcomes previously inspected. No fresh training, generalization or confirmation claim.

plan_deviation.cause: Current free/speculative memory below 512MiB; normal training gate retained.
plan_deviation.pilot: Execute standard-library low-memory retained-expert replay separately from proposed fresh-trained S5.
plan_deviation.expert_difference: Existing zero/ridge/FREM/no-JEPA distributions replace proposed adaptive-volatility/trend pool for this pilot only; no-JEPA is a strong matched control already present.
plan_deviation.fold_difference: Two existing complete folds, not three newly trained chronological folds.
plan_deviation.unexecuted_full_plan: Fresh four-expert training, new date coverage audit and precision-qualified outer folds, current-liability mandate evaluation, protected confirmation remain separate gates.

validation: Each existing validation split: first chronological half warmup and context normalization; second half temperature selection. Complete later evaluation replay with strictly matured feedback only. No evaluation selection.
context: Date aggregates of issued expert forecasts: mean(mu)/.05, log(mean(scale)/.05), population sd(mu)/.05. Center/unit from warmup only, unit floor .1, clip standardized values [-5,5]. No realized target enters context.

routing.memory: 60 matured decision dates, pooling assets by equal date/asset averaging; no per-asset pseudo-independent episodes
routing.random: Same count in fixed 182.625-day age buckets as context nearest set; seeded without labels
routing.shrinkage: ESS/(ESS+12) toward equal expert weights; weights positive sum1
routing.linear: Weighted ridge loss regression on intercept and standardized context; penalty .001 intercept and1 other coefficients; same recent24 dates and shrinkage
routing.feedback: An episode enters memory only when label maturity is strictly before prediction time; one aggregate update per date after all assets predicted.
routing.likelihood: Exact weighted Student-t mixture log score; no moment-matched Student density substitution
routing.portfolio_moments: Mixture log-return mean and total variance including between-expert variance; location ranking only, not expected simple return

generated.gate: Null context harm vs equal <=.01 nat and recurrence mean gain >0 vs equal,recent,random; otherwise stop market replay.
generated.limits: Prescribed known context signal, not financial evidence. All abrupt and delayed failures reported.

economics.candidate_policy: Inherited fixed80% equal-weight anchor,20% positive risk-adjusted signal; no policy tuning; inherited2% aggregate no-trade band
economics.volatility_managed: Equal stock basket exposure min(1,.10/sqrt(12*mean(zero_expert_variance))); conservative marginal-vol proxy, no covariance credit.
economics.primary: Seed-ensemble context net ending wealth vs equal_weight at10bps, separately in both existing folds. Also require outperformance of buy_hold,recent,random,linear to describe a broad benchmark win.
economics.stretch_target: At least6% relative ending wealth vs both equal_weight and buy_hold in each fold at10bps over its original12/10-month horizon; not annualized.
economics.cashflows: No external cashflows in this public proxy replay; not Laura liability certification.
economics.execution: Retain blind month and monthly research coordinates; no actual fills or verified historical membership.

statistics.unit: decision date, assets jointly retained; seed forecasts pooled, seeds not market replicates
statistics.intervals: Paired circular blocks3 and6 months,2000 draws seed1901 on saved net wealth increments; insufficient length retained. Conditional policy path only.
statistics.support: Descriptive pilot only, no confirmatory support or p-value selection. Report all controls/costs/folds; positive point estimates do not establish alpha.

budget.fresh_training: At most36 proposed base cells and7200seconds, blocked unless original512MiB gate passes and a complete fresh-stage protocol exists.

preservation: No modification of S3/S4 results. Freeze source and input hashes before generated/market tests; stop on failures, retain all outputs. Do not retune after outcomes.
novelty: Unestablished; online/contextual expert weighting is prior art. Pilot tests usefulness, not novelty.
